title: artgate: deterministic exit-code gates for generated game art
objective: Make 'non-sloppy' a machine-checkable property of a generated art asset rather than a judgement call, by shipping a route-independent gate harness that takes an image plus a per-style spec and returns an exit code with machine-readable reason codes. This is the spine of a planned 4-route x 4-style generation bake-off: every route feeds the same harness, so the comparison yields a decision table instead of four incomparable portfolios. Adjudication is by exit code only - no model ever grades another model's art.
acceptance_criteria: A CLI gates one image against one TOML spec and returns 0 (pass), 1 (gate failure) or 2 (harness/spec error); a malformed spec is never reported as an art verdict.
Gates implemented: ALPHA_NOT_BINARY, TOO_MANY_COLORS, OFF_PALETTE, CANVAS_SIZE, SCALE_NOT_INVARIANT, SILHOUETTE_LOW_CONTRAST, with NO_OPAQUE_PIXELS and EMPTY_CANVAS as fail-closed result codes.
Gate applicability is declared per style as data, so gates meaningless for a style (palette/colour/scale for hand-painted) are absent rather than manufacturing false failures.
Fail closed on spec faults: a gate that is declared but unimplemented, declared without its required config, or is a result-only code, raises at load time instead of silently not running.
Every numeric threshold is derived from calibration controls or a real-art corpus, never guessed.
Real hand-made CC0 art passes the full stack at a high rate; any failure is verifiable as a true positive.
100% branch coverage, zero lint suppressions, all pre-commit hooks pass.
out_of_scope: Generating any art. No route drivers, no diffusion code, no ComfyUI, no Blender - this change adds only the adjudicator.
Gates for tiling and animation (SEAM_ENERGY, LOOP_POPS, FRAME_DISTINCT). The maths exists in the seamless-tilesets and pixel-animation skills and will be lifted, not reinvented, when those cells run.
Licence gating (LICENSE_FLAG). Reserved for the sourced-CC0 route.
Committing any generated image. Binaries stay outside the repo by design; only the code lives here.
The human contact-sheet gate, which decides 'good' - the machine gates only establish 'not malformed'.
verifier: python -m pytest python_pkg/artgate/tests/ --cov=python_pkg.artgate --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100 (57 tests, 100% branch); pre-commit run --files python_pkg/artgate/*.py python_pkg/artgate/tests/*.py (ruff select=ALL, mypy strict, pylint, bandit, codespell, no-noqa); plus an end-to-end batch over 60 genuine 32x32 CC0 icons from ~/opengameart-downloads, requiring a high pass rate with every failure confirmed a true positive (58/60 = 96.7% measured).
